notes: Single-season (2020) RCBD factorial on-farm/field trial, 5 maize-cob biochar levels x 3 NPS rates, 3 replications, Guto Gida, Western Ethiopia. Only cost_return extracted this round; adoption and carbon were not extracted this round (the paper reports neither). Table 7 (p8) partial budget: Gross benefit, TVC and Net benefit extracted for every biochar treatment (T4-T15) against T1, the paper's control plot. T2 and T3 (NPS 50 and 100 kg/ha, no biochar) against T1 not extracted: their only contrast is a mineral fertiliser rate increase against zero, which is not a vocabulary practice (nutrient_mgmt_b excludes plain rate increases). Marginal rates of return not extracted: the paper's MRR column (T3 446.95, T5 22.53, T6 641.47, T8 223.37, T9 410.32, T11 464.63, T12 185.47, T14 733.68; T2 and T15 marked D) compares each NPS rate with the next lower NPS rate at the same biochar level (comparator not stated in the paper; inferred from the table layout), so every MRR contrast is NPS only with biochar in both arms, i.e. no vocabulary practice in the contrast. The vocabulary-matching biochar comparison at equal NPS (e.g. T5 vs T2) is printable from Table 7 but the paper does not make it, so it was not built. Section 3.4 text calls 61182 ETB/ha (T12) the 'minimum net benefit', which the table does not support; table values used. study_design: the paper says only that a field experiment was conducted in Guto Gida district; on-farm vs on-station not stated.
